user.title: Add VIDAA TV
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. The MAC address is read automatically from the TV's UPnP descriptor; enter it manually if that fails.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the TV, for example 10.1.1.56.
data_description.name: Friendly name for the TV. Defaults to the name reported by the TV.
data_description.mac: Ethernet MAC address. Only needed when automatic discovery fails.
data_description.port: The local MQTT broker port. The default is 36669.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV or it did not answer queries. Check the IP address and that the TV is on the network.
error.mac_not_found: Could not discover the TV's MAC address at {host}. Enter it manually.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address with 12 hexadecimal characters, for example e4:3b:c9:4c:aa:8d.

data.include_apps_in_sources: Include apps in media player sources
data.create_key_buttons: Create buttons for every remote key

data_description.wol: Send magic packets when turning the TV on. Requires the TV to be wired to Ethernet and Wake-on-LAN to be enabled.
data_description.key_delay: Seconds to wait between keys when a sequence is sent.
data_description.include_apps_in_sources: Adds all installed apps to the media player source selector.
data_description.create_key_buttons: Adds one button per supported remote key, grouped under the Remote device.
data_description.create_picture_entities: Adds the read-only picture menu tree and six writable picture sliders.
data_description.create_diagnostics: Adds model, firmware, MAC, MQTT and capability sensors.
